reviews.title: Solid PSU
reviews.comment: I think Asus uses rebranded Seasonics, but in either case, it’s always good to spend the money for a good quality PSU and this one has been working great powering up my 4070 Super. The GPU isn’t super power hungry so the 750w has been working without any issues. Simple to install with the modular cables and it’s pretty quiet when idle. It’s a very slight fan noise when it’s completely quiet. Personally I use open-back headphones and I can’t hear it at all. It’s reversible setup to show white or black is a nice concept in theory but with certain setups and customization you can’t get it to show the side of the color you want. I would rather have it all white. But that’s my only nitpick.
reviews.author: T. Tozawa

reviews.title: Reasonably priced modern, fully modular efficient  PSU
reviews.comment: Nice, modular, efficient (gold+) quiet PSU.  Plenty of power to run modern motherboards and CPUs.  The only reason you may need more is if you are running a monstrous video card.
